name: Grupo Ilha Verde (Rêgo Costa & Tavares, Lda. group)
note: Azorean automotive group (Ponta Delgada, São Miguel) whose companies include Ilha Verde Rent a Car, founded first in 1971, and dealerships for Ford, Nissan, Mazda, Hyundai, Honda, Renault and Dacia. The group's own site describes family management by founder Antero Gil Rêgo and his children.
